title: Map the European tilemap action routes
platforms: European ROM, Windows CLI via Wine
changes: Join the 12 indexed tilemap task IDs to the complete declared action and descriptor catalogs. Record the normal dispatcher predicates and the candidate slots for all four unowned routes.
validation: Wine igckgky_ authenticates three original source windows and compares all 347 action records and 684 descriptors against the exact EUR source. All 18 protected inputs passed and Wine drained.
limitations: The validated source routes identify candidate action slots. Learned availability, live inputs, managed reads, integration, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open.
